title: fresh replyer generation receipt
expectation: one exact owner message durably loaded, one bounded primary stream under maxTokens, observed usage, complete accounting
actual: receipt seq=5, draft+assistant ref durable, 1 model call, usage reported, accounting complete

title: long history replyer resume
expectation: 2500 persisted events are preserved; resume suffix + fixed title are bound; the exact new message and one generation extend the same Session
actual: same Session shiyu-replyer-verify-reply-long-1: 2500 prefix events + suffix ["session/end-seed","session/title","agent/inbox/spliced","turn/start","agent/inbox/spliced","step/start","user/message","assistant/message","step/end","turn/end"], receipt seq=2506, one call

title: foreign input during authorize(pre_step)
expectation: an unregistered native user input arriving during an authorization await blocks the stream/draft; no context receipt
actual: reply refused with "Native context inputs do not match the registered owner input"; foreign event preserved; no receipt/draft

title: foreign inbox during onBound
expectation: an unregistered pending inbox input inserted while the binding callback awaits blocks loading/acknowledgement
actual: reply refused with "Context-safe reply failed and native cleanup could not be confirmed"; no receipt or draft

title: bounded generation
expectation: maxTokens from the operation reaches the single native stream; no title/compaction model calls are counted
actual: one bounded primary stream, reported usage, no title/compaction inference events

title: same Session reply reuse
expectation: normal input reuses the native Session (no new Session), the first message/assistant remain history, and the second receipt/assistant are exact
actual: one created + one resumed Session, both exact messages and assistant drafts retained

title: stale inbox hash mismatch
expectation: only a controller declaration whose exact id+hash matches the durable input may remove it; a wrong hash blocks the reply and preserves the input
actual: reply refused with "Unknown native inbox input blocks context-safe continuation"; pending input preserved

title: known stale inbox removal
expectation: a controller-declared obsolete pending input is removed by its exact id/hash, the removal events are re-read into the baseline, and the reply proceeds with an empty inbox
actual: one exact removal (seq=402) bound into the baseline; inbox empty; reply receipt seq=408

title: replyer adapter restart
expectation: a new adapter instance + persisted binding resumes the same native Session, preserves history and produces a second exact receipt with one bounded generation
actual: restarted adapter resumed shiyu-replyer-c28678b8-2d82-4a12-abf4-696df9144767, preserved 9 durable events and generated one bounded reply

title: pending inbox blocks generation
expectation: unknown pending input blocks the reply before any model call; no receipt
actual: reply refused with "Unknown native inbox input blocks context-safe continuation"; zero model calls
